subject: general
question: Which popular folk dance of Himachal Pradesh has a Yagya performed by the dancers at the end of the dance performance as a homage to the Gods and Goddesses?
solution:
The correct answer is__** Nati**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Nati**

 
 
• The very famous folk dance of **Himachal Pradesh **is known as **Nati**.
 
• Himachal has not forgotten about its **rich culture **and **historical heritage**, even after modernisation.
 
• Nati is mostly connected to Himachal Pradesh's **Kullu district**.
 
• The dance tells the story of** Krishna and the Gopis** and represents the Raas Lila. 
 
• **Tunis **is the name given to musicians in this region and they perform using the **dhol, flute, nagara, karnal, narsingha, and a shenai**.
 
• The dancers conduct a **Yagya** as a homage to the **Gods** and **Goddesses** at the end of a Nati dance.
